gameDescriptionHtml:
A unique, infinitely replayable, story-driven hybrid between a deck-building Roguelike and an RPG game. Explore the ever-changing maps, fight with deadly enemies, and learn what happened to the cursed island of Avalon.

Game Features

  • Unique blend of deck builder roguelike and RPG.
  • Create your own combos.
  • Discover dark re-imagination of Arthurian legends
  • Complete quests, save NPCs, and build your village.
  • Customize your character with cool and variety of features (9 unique hero classes to choose from).
